items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: Date input with a calendar popup: locale-formatted text field (parsed on blur, invalid text shows a Field error), trigger button opening the Calendar in the Popover, single and range variants, Field label, description and error, and focus return to the trigger on close.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Text input in the locale format (default ko-KR, e.g. 2026. 11. 14.) plus a trigger button that opens the Calendar in the yorha Popover. Typed text is parsed on blur or Enter; text that is not a date, or a day that is disabled or outside minDate/maxDate, marks the Field invalid with an error message (invalidMessage, outOfRangeMessage). Label, description and error come from the yorha Field. Escape, picking a day (single) or the range end closes the popup and returns focus to the trigger. DateRangePicker accepts typed ranges separated by ~, – or ' - ' in either order. Pass name to submit ISO dates through hidden inputs (name, or name-from and name-to). Set lang on the wrapper for CJK leading.
